title: Meteor Crater
description: A rock from space punched this hole, and one family owns it. Meteor Crater in Arizona is 1,200 meters wide. Would you buy a crater? Imagery: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics. Photos: D. Roddy / U.S. Geological Survey, Wikimedia Commons. Source: Wikipedia.

beats.text: A rock from space punched this hole, and one family owns it.
It is Meteor Crater in Arizona, often called the best preserved impact crater on Earth.
It is twelve hundred meters wide and one hundred seventy meters deep.
The rock that made it was only fifty meters across.
It hit about fifty thousand years ago, and most of it vaporized.
For years, geologists were sure a volcano had done it.
A mining man named Barringer bet on a meteorite. His family still owns the crater.
